applicability: Family and member review of recorded before/after family context.
conditions: The context owner supplies exact selected family revisions and delivered members; absent partial-roster content is never invented.
Guarantee, member statement and realization/path content are open main-page resolution, while evidence and selected-record knowledge follow as separately owned content.
exclusions: A partial roster remains partial until its continuation is read; no absent sibling content is invented.
Displayed context is not an authored assessment or proof that a family guarantee is preserved.
Guarantee/member statement display in tree rows.
statement: The main-page family/member center keeps the independently authored guarantee and unchanged carried member statements beside the selected intent and its bound expressions. The compact navigation tree does not display those statements.
